item.description: ECC is an agent harness performance optimization system designed for AI coding assistants like Claude Code, Codex, and Opencod. It bundles skills, instincts, memory, security, and a research-first development approach, enabling developers to fine-tune their agents for better stability and intelligence. This matters because it transforms raw AI tools into more reliable, context-aware programming partners.

item.title: [github_trending] OpenCut-app/OpenCut
item.description: OpenCut is an open-source video editor designed as a free alternative to CapCut. It offers powerful editing features without any subscription or watermark, making it ideal for content creators who want full control over their tools. The project is cross-platform and community-driven, ensuring transparency and continuous improvement. For anyone tired of paid video editors or restrictive platforms, OpenCut provides a flexible and privacy-respecting solution.

item.title: [github_trending] ocornut/imgui
item.description: Dear ImGui is a bloat-free graphical user interface library for C++ with minimal dependencies, offering a seamless immediate mode GUI experience. It is especially popular among game developers and tool builders who need quick, interactive panels for debugging or real-time data visualization without the overhead of traditional UI frameworks. Its focus on simplicity and performance makes it a go-to choice for indie games and embedded tools.

item.title: [github_trending] koala73/worldmonitor
item.description: Worldmonitor is an AI-powered real-time global intelligence dashboard that aggregates news, monitors geopolitical events, and tracks infrastructure status in a single unified view. Designed for analysts, journalists, and business leaders, it enables rapid situational awareness and informed decision-making by consolidating diverse data streams into an accessible interface. Its significance lies in simplifying complex global monitoring and helping professionals stay ahead of critical developments.

item.title: [github_trending] ComposioHQ/awesome-claude-skills
item.description: This curated collection brings together a wealth of tips, resources, and tools for customizing Claude AI workflows. Think of it as a practical handbook that helps developers quickly find best practices for extending Claude's capabilities, from prompt engineering to integrating external APIs. For developers and AI enthusiasts who want to tailor Claude to their specific needs, this repository saves countless hours of searching by providing ready-to-use guides and efficiency hacks.

This trend demonstrates that internal combustion engines still have relevance, particularly in long-haul transport and off-road scenarios, challenging the narrative of an inevitable all-electric future.

item.description: SpaceX's Starship prototype successfully completed a high-speed reentry test and splashed down in the Indian Ocean, marking a major milestone for the program. item.description: This article features Wang Hong, an entrepreneur or expert, who shares a philosophy of taking time to think slowly in a fast-paced world. It resonates with readers overwhelmed by constant pressure, offering a thoughtful perspective on patience and deliberate decision-making in both business and life.

item.title: [36kr] 东方甄选闷声赚麻了
item.description: Oriental Selection has been quietly raking in massive profits amid the livestream e-commerce boom. Leveraging the knowledge-infused hosting style of Dong Yuhui and a self-branded product lineup, the company transformed from a tutoring giant into a retail powerhouse on Douyin. It not only survived the crackdown on private education but thrived, proving that compelling cultural content can build a lucrative business empire—a lesson for anyone watching the new retail and livestreaming space.

item.title: [36kr] 20斤一个的巨型西瓜，为何在中国绝迹了？
item.description: Giant watermelons weighing 20 to 30 jin (10–15 kg) were once a common sight on Chinese streets, but they've all but disappeared. Today's consumers prefer smaller, 3–5 jin melons. The shift reflects changes in variety breeding, logistics costs, and eating habits—large melons are hard to transport and often go to waste. This evolution shows how Chinese agriculture has adapted to modern retail and smaller households, a fascinating glimpse into the country's changing food culture.

item.title: [36kr] 广西县城，即将跑出一个IPO
item.description: A company from a small county in Guangxi is about to go public, challenging the stereotype that only first-tier cities spawn IPO-worthy firms. This case shows that county-level economies can nurture companies strong enough to list, thanks to local specialty industries and meticulous operations. It's an inspiring reminder for investors and local entrepreneurs that with the right niche, a business can thrive even in a seemingly remote area.

item.title: [36kr] 买不起大疆、影石的年轻人，排队租运动相机
item.description: Young people who can't afford DJI or Insta360 action cameras and drones are flocking to rental services instead. By renting, they get to use top-tier gear for trips and outdoor adventures without paying thousands upfront. Rental platforms are booming, sometimes with waiting lists. This trend highlights a shift from ownership to usage among budget-conscious consumers, and it's creating a new sweet spot for the sharing economy in the outdoor tech space.

For tech leaders, understanding this trend helps craft smarter AI strategies that avoid the trap of scale-at-all-costs.

item.title: [hackernews] Claude Opus 5

For developers and researchers seeking a powerful AI assistant for coding, writing, and analysis, this release marks a significant leap in productivity.

item.description: OpenAI and Hugging Face disclosed a security incident that occurred during a model evaluation, involving potential data exposure risks. This incident highlights that AI model evaluation stages are not immune to attacks, especially in collaborative and open-testing environments, underscoring the need for rigorous security review processes to protect sensitive data.

item.description: Recent neuroscience research reaffirms that handwriting engages the brain's learning and memory centers far more deeply than typing. The coordinated fine motor movements, visual feedback, and spatial awareness involved in putting pen to paper enhance information processing, leading to better comprehension and long-term retention. item.title: [hackernews] Android May Soon Restrict On-Device ADB
item.description: Reports suggest Android may soon restrict on-device ADB access to improve security, as malicious apps often abuse ADB permissions for silent installations or data theft. However, this change could impact developers and power users who rely on local ADB for convenient debugging and automation. If you frequently use ADB over USB or Wi-Fi for development, keep an eye on upcoming Android releases — they might require alternative methods like remote debugging through authorized hosts.

item.title: [hackernews] If coding has been solved, why does software keep getting worse?
item.description: This article pushes back against the claim that AI has solved coding, asking why software keeps getting worse if that were true. The author argues that AI code assistants generate plenty of code quickly but lack understanding of architecture, maintainability, and long-term reliability, leading to technical debt. item.title: [hackernews] It's getting harder to focus every day
item.description: This piece dives into the growing struggle to maintain focus in a distraction-saturated world. It blames endless social media feeds, information overload, and multitasking culture for eroding our attention spans. More than a personal willpower issue, the author argues it's a systemic problem of digital environment design, urging a rethink of tools and habits to preserve deep thinking.

item.title: [hackernews] AI Companies Are Trying to Hide a Staggering Amount of Debt
item.description: This article shines a light on the staggering hidden debts AI companies are carrying—undisclosed hardware procurement bills, data center construction loans, and inflated talent costs. As funding tightens, these liabilities could become ticking time bombs for startups. It's a stark reminder for investors and practitioners to look beyond model benchmarks and examine financial health.

item.title: [hackernews] India's first privately-developed rocket reaches orbit on debut launch

Built by Skyroot Aerospace and named Vikram-S, the rocket demonstrated low-cost, responsive launch capabilities, boosting confidence in India's commercial space sector. For space enthusiasts and satellite operators, this means a new reliable option for deploying small satellites quickly and affordably, potentially reshaping the global launch market.

item.title: [producthunt] PromptQL

It also enables creators to repurpose written content into engaging video podcasts automatically.
